definition: A strong, regular, repeated pattern of sound or movement.
sentence: The drummer kept a steady rhythm all night.

definition: A chart showing the days, weeks, and months of a year.
sentence: She marked her dentist appointment on the calendar.

definition: To move or keep apart.
sentence: Please separate the recycling from the trash.

definition: To make someone feel awkward or ashamed.
sentence: He didn't mean to embarrass her in front of the class.

definition: A special right or advantage granted to a person or group.
sentence: Driving is a privilege, not a right.

definition: Without any doubt.
sentence: She is definitely coming to dinner.

definition: Required in order to achieve something.
sentence: Bring only what is necessary for the hike.

definition: A particular time when something happens, or a special event.
sentence: He wore his best suit for the occasion.

definition: A place where meals are prepared and served to customers.
sentence: They tried the new Thai restaurant downtown.

definition: Strange or unusual in an unsettling way.
sentence: A weird noise came from the attic.

definition: A flash of light produced by electricity during a storm.
sentence: Lightning lit up the whole valley.
notes: Do not confuse with 'lightening', meaning making lighter.

definition: A plant, or part of a plant, eaten as food.
sentence: He grows every vegetable in his own garden.

definition: A burial ground for the dead.
sentence: The old cemetery sits on a hill above town.

definition: A disagreement expressed in words.
sentence: They had a brief argument about the bill.

definition: Ornaments such as rings and necklaces worn on the body.
sentence: She keeps her jewelry in a wooden box.
notes: British spelling 'jewellery' is a legitimate variant. Decide in advance whether to allow it.

definition: Feeling or showing thanks.
sentence: We are grateful for your help.

definition: A formal promise that something will be done or will work.
sentence: The tools come with a lifetime guarantee.

definition: The measurement of something from bottom to top.
sentence: Please write your height on the form.

definition: A cutting tool with two blades joined in the middle.
sentence: He cut the ribbon with a pair of scissors.

definition: Something unexpected.
sentence: Her visit was a wonderful surprise.

definition: An upright pillar, or a vertical division on a page.
sentence: A marble column held up the porch roof.

definition: Complete with regard to every detail.
sentence: The inspector gave the house a thorough review.
notes: Distinguish clearly from 'through' and 'though' when pronouncing.

definition: Coming after the eleventh in a sequence.
sentence: This is the twelfth year of the festival.

definition: An object kept as a reminder of a place or event.
sentence: She bought a small souvenir at the museum.

definition: The second month of the year.
sentence: Her birthday falls in early February.
